model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the loss over the number of iterations for different configurations of a machine learning model, specifically a variant of the SepLLM model. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," is linear and ranges from 0 to 140,000 iterations, with tick labels at intervals of 20,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," is also linear and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different model configuration. The "Vanilla" model is depicted by a purple line, the "StrmLLM (n=64)" by a blue line, the "SepLLM (n=64)" by an orange line, the "SepLLM (n=64, H)" by a green line, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" by a red line, and the "SepLLM (n=128)" by a dark blue line. All lines start at a high loss value and decrease as the number of iterations increases, indicating an improvement in model performance over time. The lines converge towards the end of the plot, suggesting that the different configurations are approaching a similar level of loss.
